title: An Aberration on the Line
description: The Historian's next useful proof is one Fathoms calls an aberration. Catch one through the native fishing progression rather than substituting an unrelated monster or trophy.
description_completed: An aberration has come up on your line. The investigation can move from catches to what the depths keep locked away.

dialogue.offer: Bait proves the method. An aberration proves the waters are worth studying. Catch one and return.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: There it is. That is enough to move past ordinary fishing records.
dialogue.completed: One aberration is evidence. The next question is what lies sealed below.
